articles.title: Bitcoin miner Cipher posts $31 million profit as AI pivot begins
articles.snippet: The company's revenue dropped 63% in the third quarter, while a $127 million accounting gain helped turn an operating loss into a reported profit.

articles.title: SpaceX blocks tokenized stock listing on OKXICE despite offshore trading boom
articles.snippet: SpaceX joined several other issuers objecting to OKXICE tokenized trading, months after crypto platforms offered tokens tied to its shares.

articles.title: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort in a move that risked flipping it to new resistance.

articles.title: Anthropic's AI Is Getting Cheaper to Use. That's Becoming a Problem for Its Business
articles.snippet: Claude's prices are falling, but Anthropic's computing expenses grew faster than sales in the latest quarter—a tricky equation ahead of its IPO.

articles.title: Epidemic of Hacked Freezers Spreads Across Europe
articles.snippet: A suspected hacking wave has pushed supermarket freezers into defrost mode across ten European countries, with temperatures reportedly hitting 50°C. Nobody knows who's behind it or why it spread.
